contea di ritrovamento: Wiltshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn Roman copper-alloy 3rd-century radiate of Gallienus (sole reign 260-268AD, Reece Issue Period 13; Cunetio 1345), 'DIANAE CONS AUG' reverse, officina Γ. The obverse legend of GALLIENVS AVG is missing; it could have been worn off, but there is no trace of most of the letters. This coin has an oval flan 18.4mm x 16.9; weight 1.7g
